svg.title: Bedtime story evaluator and optimizer
svg.desc: Python validates input, drafts and judges stories through Claude Haiku 5.5, and releases an approved draft or a prewritten fallback. Every revision returns to the judge.

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
